    middle_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.95, y=3.0, width=0.2, height=0.2, density=200)
    
    # Right strip beams (13.4-13.6) with 2 beams
    right_beams = []
    right_beams.append(sandbox.add_beam(x=13.45, y=1.0, width=0.2, height=0.2, density=200))
    right_beams.append(sandbox.add_beam(x=13.45, y=6.0, width=0.2, height=0.2, density=200))
    
    # Connect left beams vertically
    for i in range(8):
        anchor_y = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i+1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i+1], anchor_point=(12.45, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect middle beam to left beam at y=3.0
    anchor_x = (12.95 + 12.45) / 2
    anchor_y = 3.0
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, left_beams[3], anchor_point=(anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect middle beam to right beams
    anchor_x_right = (12.95 + 13.45) / 2
    anchor_y_right_0 = (3.0 + 1.0) / 2
    anchor_y_right_1 = (3.0 + 6.0) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_beams[0], anchor_point=(anchor_x_right, anchor_y_right_0), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_beams[1], anchor_point=(anchor_x_right, anchor_y_right_1), type='rigid')
    
    return middle_beam
